name: Gaidou
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of [url=/c92663]Mihoshi[/url]'s close friends from her time working for the cult.
Gaidou is a person who doesn't speak much. Instead, he is always found chewing gum, which makes people feel uncomfortable.
Likes clothes that give him a younger appearance.
